note: Vietnam real GDP growth, % year-on-year (constant prices), as first published in the GSO/NSO (Tổng cục Thống kê / Cục Thống kê, nso.gov.vn) quarterly socio-economic press release for each quarter; full-year rows ('2018' etc.) are the estimate in that year's Q4/full-year release. Exceptions: 2018-Q2 taken from the 6-month 2018 press release; 2020-Q2 from the GSO press-conference article for Q2/6M 2020 (the standalone press-release URL returns 404). All URLs fetched 2026-11-09 with a browser User-Agent and returned HTTP 200; each figure was matched against the page text. First releases were later revised, as shown in subsequent GSO releases, e.g.: 2018-Q1 7.38->7.45, 2018-Q2 6.79->6.73; 2019-Q1 6.79->6.82, 2019-Q3 7.31->7.48; 2020-Q1 3.82->3.68; 2021-Q1 4.48->4.72; 2022-Q2 7.72->7.99 (later 8.56), 2022-Q3 13.67->14.38; 2023-Q1/Q2/Q3 3.32/4.14/5.33 -> 3.41/4.25/5.47 (Q4/2023 release); 2024-Q1/Q2/Q3 5.66/6.93/7.40 -> 5.98/7.25/7.43 (Q4/2024 release); 2025-Q1/Q2/Q3 6.93/7.96/8.23 -> 7.05/8.16/8.25 (Q4/2025 release; Q1/2025 later cited as 7.07); 2026-Q1/Q2 7.83/8.39 -> 8.15/8.81 (Q3/2026 release). Full-year figures are also preliminary estimates and may have been revised in later yearbooks (e.g. after the 2019 GDP rebasing/re-assessment of scale). For a consistent revised series use the latest GSO release or statistical yearbook instead.
